Full summary: Shipped the D7 fix (TDD): per-decision affected_files/affected_symbols on twining_record structured decisions — override session-level, fall back when absent; loop clobber removed; 4 tests incl. zod-retention. Full suite 1549 green.
Decisions: Chose per-decision-overrides-session-level precedence with session-level as fallback (input.affected_files ?? args.affected_files ?? []) over per-decision-only — mirrors the shipped assumptions/constraints precedence and the per-decision status precedent (01KY87YQ6GG47BX6X5QVHPENSC), and keeps every existing caller's behavior identical; NL string decisions keep session-level lists unchanged; Chose to test the zod half of D7 via the registered tool's inputSchema.safeParse asserting field RETENTION (not just acceptance) — the unit harness calls handlers directly and would never catch a schema that strips the key; follows the shipped safeParse precedent (01KY74M6184S3Z8G700RGGSYH8); Chose semver minor 2.8.0 over patch — the fix adds new input-schema surface (two per-decision fields), matching the 2.7.0 convention of minor for additive field-defect releases; plugin 1.26.0 minor for the RECORD-07 behavior addition
Findings: RECORD-07 added to plugin/BEHAVIORS.md documenting per-decision affected_files with the server >=2.8 caveat (earlier servers silently drop the nested field) — field repos on older servers must keep their twining_decide carrier rule until they upgrade
